name: HQQ (half-quadratic quantization)
kernels: HQQ dequant kernels in optimum-quanto / HF HQQ integration
quality_delta: Only a cross-model claim, not a controlled fp16 delta: HQQ-quantized Llama-2-70B at 2-bit is reported as outperforming full-precision Llama-2-13B at comparable memory (quant-hqq-blog). The comparable controlled claim is speed: HQQ quantizes Llama-2-70B in under 5 minutes, reported as >50x faster than GPTQ (quant-hqq-blog).
notes: HQQ is calibration-free by design: it minimizes weight-reconstruction error directly with a half-quadratic (proximal) solver rather than using a calibration set to minimize layer-output error. The upstream claim is that this reaches calibration-based quality at calibration-free speed, which is a genuinely different tradeoff from AWQ/GPTQ, not a weaker version of them. Weight-only - group size is not part of the defining scheme, hence null rather than a guess. Provenance warning: HQQ has NO arXiv paper. The only primary technical source found is the Dropbox/Mobius engineering blog (the 2023 post republished 2025-10-22 with an editor's note), so every HQQ number here is vendor-claim-grade and confidence is kept low. Do not cite an 'HQQ paper'.
